summary: Main-road kerb by the motorway bridge, no parked cars, homes beside it.

drivers.seclusion: Houses and a large white building sit right on the south side along the kerb.

drivers.traffic: Busy road beside the Centenary Motorway ramp.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along the kerb; No Stopping Any Time sign nearby.
